utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, the repair drive? I'm not really in the loop—I just skimmed something about it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, it's this Saturday! We're patching up the community garden shed. It's a fun little project—can I count you in?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, this Saturday? I'll try to swing by if I can get my chores done, but no promises.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, Jules just asked if I'm free Saturday morning for a repair drive at Sam's garage. I really need to get my dates straight.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, a repair drive at Sam's garage? I was hoping to get my porch step looked at—do you think they're still taking names?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think they are, but I'm not 100% sure. Maybe we can both check with Sam later.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything important for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane. We're starting at 9 AM sharp—fixing the shed door and benches. I'll be there at 8 to set up if you want to join early.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks Eli, I'll aim to be there at 8 to lend a hand with setup.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Rosa, are you still coming to the repair drive this Saturday? We're starting at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Vik, I think you might have the wrong date—it's actually been moved to Sunday at the community center, still at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, really? Thanks for the heads up, Rosa! So it's Sunday at 9 AM instead—I'll let everyone know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Rey, you heard about the repair drive next Saturday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'll be there to help out. Good to see others interested too.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, glad you're on board! I'm planning to stop by around 9 after my store run.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey, I can help coordinate the repair drive around school pickup times if that's useful.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Faye, that's wonderful! I had a toaster... somewhere... but I'm sure someone'll find it at the drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll add you to the morning team — we can get everything set up before the bell rings.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, great to see you! Are you thinking of joining the repair drive on Saturday? We've got a solid crew coming together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to help, but can you remind me which repair drive? I recall hearing about one for the community center's computers. Is that the one?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, that's a different one! The one this Saturday is a general neighborhood repair drive at Sam's garage—fixing things like porch steps and broken chairs. Want me to add you to the list?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Morning works for me. I'll grab my tools and meet you by the drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, Leo! See you at the community center at 10 AM sharp on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, 10 AM at the community center. I'll bring my tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is going to fix anything? I've seen these things fail before.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Rosa told me it's for clothes and small appliances — what makes you think it won't work?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, Rosa’s not exactly an expert, is she? Have you actually seen one of these work before?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just hope everyone remembers to check in at the sign-up sheet tomorrow—otherwise it'll be chaos trying to keep track of who's doing what.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh absolutely, Pia! I've got a master list going at home, and I'll bring copies to the center first thing—I don't want anyone feeling lost.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief, Tess — a master list will help a lot. Maybe we can set up a quick check-in table right at the entrance to keep people from wandering off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Mara, glad you're here! We're set for next Saturday—Uli's bringing metalwork tools, and Jules is rallying help from the book club. Should be a good day.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great to hear! I've got the tool inventory sorted and teams assigned. Should be a smooth operation.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Awesome, Mara—thanks for handling the logistics. I'll make sure my garage is open early so we can grab any extra supplies folks might need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll grab a few extra screws from my shed, just in case we run short.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great thinking, Uli! I'll check my stash too and we can compare notes before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sounds good, Cleo. I'll swing by your place Friday evening with what I've got.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, are you planning to come to the repair drive? I've got extra tools if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is actually needed? I haven't noticed any problems myself.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Well, I've noticed a few fences and gates around that could use some TLC, and it's a great chance for neighbors to help each other out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I'm glad you're here, Mina! We're collecting gently used tools and small appliances — anything we can fix up and donate back to the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: So if I stop by my shed, I've got an old blender and a hand saw that could use some love. Think they'd be useful?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, those sound perfect for the drive! And just a quick note — we've moved it to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Right, Saturday at 9 at the school gate. I'll bring some sorting bins, but just a pair of gloves for yourself should do.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I'll grab my gloves and see if anyone from the book club wants to carpool over.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, carpooling's a great idea! I can send out a quick text to the parent group about meeting points if that helps coordinate everyone.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check my supply shed right now, Pia. Last I counted, we had about a dozen patch kits, but I'll make sure we're set.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be great, Cleo—I just want to make sure we don't run out mid-morning like last time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'll head over to the shed now and give you a full count before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, perfect timing then! So what's my role in all this?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Your role? Oh, I think I remember—there was a list... was it on the fridge or under my lucky scone?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ha, knowing you, Oren, it's probably under the scone! But seriously, did I miss a sign-up sheet or something?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right—the repair drive. I think we're good on supplies, honestly.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's great, Bo! I'll let everyone know we're set on supplies—and I'll mention you're coming at 9:05 as usual!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, did I say 9:05? I thought it was 9. Anyway, sounds good—I'll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hana, good to see you! Got any tools you need me to bring to Sunday's repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm sorry, Gus, but I need to clarify—are you talking about the community center's computer repair drive this Saturday? I want to make sure we're on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, I see the mix-up! The drive was moved to Sunday. Rosa told me about the change—hope you can still make it on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'm planning to be there this Saturday. Happy to help out with whatever's needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I'll be there at 8 to start setting up. Want to join me for the early shift?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can do early. I'll bring some coffee for us.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, repair drive—is that Saturday or tomorrow? I swear Dane said to grab my gear tonight, but Jules mentioned Saturday...

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Saturday, definitely Saturday! Don't listen to Dane—he gets his days mixed up. I've got a whole list of folks bringing things, and Vik's already promised to help sort.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, okay—Saturday. I'll mark it down this time, I promise. Thanks, Tess!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Saturday at 10 AM sharp—I'll have the tool inventory all sorted by then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Good, I'll bring my angle grinder and welding rods. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks Uli. I'll make sure the inventory sheet has those items listed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So you're handling both the playground bench and a repair drive? That's a lot on your plate. How's Cleo's car doing?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Cleo's car is fine — the drive just needs a patch. I've got tomorrow morning free for it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So it's the driveway that needs work, not a broken-down car? Got it. You sure you can handle both that and the bench tomorrow morning?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Quinn, please do! The more hands we have, the faster we'll get through these repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, Mara, I've been hearing about this repair drive—do you know if there's still a spot on the sign-up sheet for my porch step?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Nell, I saved a spot on the list for your porch step. We’ll get to it after the tool sorting.
